description: Draws a grid of characters from a font ROM (Add Font ROM) over a video picture: its own text RAM with a colour per cell (16-colour palette), written at any time or loaded from a hex file, scaling, an optional background. Layers chain; LATENCY = FONT_LATENCY + 2 clocks.

de.description: Zeichnet ein Zeichenraster aus einem Font-ROM (Add Font ROM) über ein Videobild: eigener Text-RAM mit einer Farbe pro Zelle (Palette mit 16 Farben), jederzeit beschreibbar oder aus einer Hex-Datei geladen, Skalierung, optionaler Hintergrund. Ebenen lassen sich verketten; LATENCY = FONT_LATENCY + 2 Takte.
de.name: Text-Ebene

name: Text layer

parameters.description: The font's cell width in pixels (a power of two)
parameters.name: CELL_WIDTH

parameters.description: The font's cell height in pixels (a power of two)
parameters.name: CELL_HEIGHT

parameters.description: Each font pixel is 2^SCALE_SHIFT screen pixels wide and high
parameters.name: SCALE_SHIFT

parameters.description: Screen column of the grid's left edge
parameters.name: TEXT_X

parameters.description: Screen row of the grid's top edge
parameters.name: TEXT_Y

parameters.description: Width of the font ROM reader's code input
parameters.name: CODE_BITS

parameters.description: The font ROM reader's read latency
parameters.name: FONT_LATENCY

parameters.description: Hex file with the starting text, one word per cell (colour, code: F41 is a white A); empty: blank
parameters.name: INIT_FILE

parameters.description: The code of an empty cell when there is no INIT_FILE
parameters.name: BLANK_CODE

parameters.description: 1: the grid's cells show BACKGROUND_COLOUR where there is no ink
parameters.name: BACKGROUND

parameters.description: 16 colours as 24'hRRGGBB each, index 0 in the lowest bits; the CGA palette by default (15 is white)
parameters.name: PALETTE

ports.description: Pixel column from video_timing (or the previous layer's x_out)
ports.name: x

ports.description: Data enable: the pixel is visible
ports.name: de

ports.description: Write write_code and write_colour into the cell at write_address
ports.name: write

ports.description: Cell to write: row × COLUMNS + column
ports.name: write_address

ports.description: To the font ROM reader's code
ports.name: font_code

ports.description: To the font ROM reader's row
ports.name: font_row

ports.description: To the font ROM reader's column
ports.name: font_column

ports.description: From the font ROM reader: pixel
ports.name: font_pixel

ports.description: A character draws this output pixel
ports.name: ink
